fp1_china_action.label: 中国实质行动(唯一可行聚点注入)
fp1_china_action.findings: China escalated diplomatic but not military involvement: (1) Iran 5/14 approved selective Chinese vessel passage through Hormuz via new 'Persian Gulf Strait Authority' permit mechanism (Fars/Tasnim) — material bilateral concession coinciding with Trump-Xi summit; (2) Trump-Xi Beijing summit 5/14-15 focused on Hormuz, Trump publicly said Xi 'agrees Iran must reopen strait' & 'would like to help' but Xi ruled out military assistance, only diplomatic; (3) Iranian FM Araghchi visited Beijing early May, China called for end to war & Hormuz reopening; (4) 4/7 China+Russia vetoed Bahrain Hormuz escort UNSC resolution citing 'root causes'; (5) Xi's April 4-point Middle East peace plan still on table; (6) Trump considering lifting US sanctions on Chinese oil cos buying Iranian crude as quid pro quo. Analysts (Carnegie/EIU): Beijing balancing Iran/Gulf/US, no proactive role; Pakistan remains practical mediator with China giving 'political weight'.

fp2_us_signal_inconsistency.label: 美方信号包内部矛盾(承诺解锁前导)
fp2_us_signal_inconsistency.findings: Trump's contradictory signaling structurally escalated: (1) PROJECT FREEDOM PAUSED 5/5 after ~36hrs citing 'Great Progress' on deal BUT (2) BLOCKADE OF IRAN PORTS REMAINS ACTIVE since 4/13 (M/day Iran losses per WH Op Economic Fury); (3) Trump 5/7 threatens 'intense bombing... much higher level and intensity than before' if Iran rejects deal — simultaneously pursuing diplomacy and escalation; (4) Two competing 14-point proposals: US 14-pt (no enrichment 12yrs, hand over 440kg 60% HEU, gradual sanctions relief, blockade withdrawal, strait reopen 30 days post-signing) vs Iran 14-pt counter; (5) Iran chief negotiator Ghalibaf 5/12 ultimatum 'accept or face failure'; (6) Trump 5/11 declares ceasefire 'on life support'; (7) Hegseth 5/12 Senate testimony: Trump doesn't need Congress to restart strikes — Article 2 authority; (8) FDD analysts: pausing PF 'strategic mistake', should resume.

fp3_face_saving_framework.label: 面子工程原材料出现
fp3_face_saving_framework.findings: Multiple competing framework tracks: (1) Original ceasefire (4/8 Pakistan-brokered) framework: immediate halt + Hormuz reopen + 15-20 day negotiations — extended indefinitely 4/21 by Trump; (2) Failed Islamabad 4/11-12 high-level talks ended w/o agreement (nuclear + Hormuz access conflicts); (3) US 14-point proposal vs Iran 14-point counter — Trump rejected Iran's counteroffer 5/11 ('life support'); (4) UN SC closed consultations 5/6 (Bahrain-requested re: 5/4 UAE attacks); (5) Resolution 2817 (3/11) condemned Iran attacks on Gulf states, 13-0-2 (China/Russia abstain); (6) Bahrain Hormuz-escort draft 4/7 vetoed by China+Russia; (7) Iran retains red line: no direct talks pre-blockade lift; (8) Xi's 4-point ME peace plan still on table; (9) Times of Israel reports US-Iran 'closing in on framework for permanent deal' even as Trump renews bomb threats — bifurcated track.

noise_filter.rule: 按行为类型分类,不按人物分类
noise: 巴盖伊等发言人声明(言辞)
媒体'消息人士'报道(未验证)
signal: Trump签署行政令/军事命令(行动)
美军实际调兵/部署变化(行动)
IRGC实际攻击模式变化(行动)
中国实际经济/军事动作(行动)
noise_filter.key_distinction: 同一个人的言辞=噪声,行动=信号。Trump说'just for fun'=噪声。Trump命令打Kharg=信号。

pipeline_daily_checklist: 1. 物理层: 更新Q1(袭击频率) + Q2(通行量) + Q3(SPR释放)
2. 焦点层: 扫描fp1(中国动作) + fp2(美方矛盾) + fp3(退出框架) + fp4(成本阈值)
3. 噪声过滤: 新闻分类为action vs rhetoric
4. 结构性验证: 跑structural_verify检查盲区+停滞+链断裂
5. DAG更新: 只有物理层变化或焦点层信号触发才更新概率
